findings.oracle: ProviderConfig() default dataclass; oracle = documented field defaults in config.py docstring; asserts enabled is True, api_base is None, default_model is None, timeout_seconds==120, max_retries==3 exactly.
ToolConfig() default; oracle = ToolConfig dataclass spec; asserts enabled True, path None, auto_install True, startup_timeout_seconds==60, port None.
SandboxConfig() default; oracle = SandboxConfig spec; asserts all 4 fields enabled True, timeout_seconds==300, memory_limit_mb==2048, network_enabled False.
UIConfig() default; oracle = UIConfig spec; asserts all 4 fields theme=='system', font_family=='JetBrains Mono', font_size==11, show_tool_calls True.
SessionConfig() default; oracle = SessionConfig spec; asserts all 3 fields auto_save True, save_interval_seconds==300, retention_days==7.
LogConfig() default; oracle = LogConfig spec; asserts all 7 fields level=='INFO', file_enabled True, console_enabled True, max_file_size_mb==10, backup_count==5, retention_days==14, json_file True.

Config.default(); oracle = _default_providers/_default_tools factories; asserts exact provider set (8) and tool set (5), provider-specific OLLAMA api_base/timeout and LOCAL_TRANSFORMERS model/max_retries, tool-specific GHIDRA port==4768/timeout==120 and PROCESS auto_install False, plus exact top-level section set.

Real tmp_path dirs; oracle = filesystem is_dir(); happy path plus nested-parents, idempotent (preserves sentinel file), and file-collision raising FileExistsError/NotADirectoryError edge cases in separate tests.

Config.default().get_provider_config(ANTHROPIC); oracle = stored default instance; asserts identity (is providers[ANTHROPIC]), all field values, and distinctness from OLLAMA's stored config (different api_base).

Config(providers={}).get_provider_config(GROK) twice; oracle = fresh ProviderConfig() default; asserts first is not second, both == ProviderConfig(), and mutation of one does not bleed into next (no shared cache).
Config.default().get_tool_config(GHIDRA); oracle = GHIDRA default; asserts identity, GHIDRA port==4768/timeout==120, and contrast vs X64DBG (port None, timeout 30) proving tool specificity.
Config with ANTHROPIC disabled and OPENAI enabled; oracle = explicit enabled flags; asserts False for disabled, True for enabled, and True on default config.
Config with GHIDRA disabled and X64DBG enabled; oracle = explicit flags; asserts False/True distinction plus True on default.

Config with non-default values across all sections -> _to_dict -> from_dict; oracle = original instance; asserts every section (providers, tools, sandbox, ui, session, log, provider/confirmation) round-trips field-for-field via dataclass equality.
Config.from_dict({}) vs Config.default(); oracle = Config.default(); asserts every section equal (providers, tools, sandbox, ui, session, log, provider, confirmation).
from_dict with only custom general; oracle = Config.default() for other sections; asserts custom provider/confirmation applied AND all other sections equal default.

from_dict default_provider='nonexistent' under structlog capture_logs; oracle = ANTHROPIC fallback + warning event; asserts fallback value plus exactly one config_invalid_provider_name warning with value/fallback fields.

from_dict confirmation_level='badvalue' under capture_logs; oracle = DESTRUCTIVE fallback + warning; asserts fallback plus one config_invalid_confirmation_level warning with value=='badvalue', fallback=='destructive'.

parse_providers with anthropic override + unknown key under capture_logs; oracle = _EXPECTED_PROVIDERS set; asserts exact keyset/count==8, override applied, untouched provider keeps default, one config_unknown_provider_skipped warning.

parse_tools with ghidra disable + unknown key under capture_logs; oracle = _EXPECTED_TOOLS set; asserts exact keyset/count==5, GHIDRA disabled but keeps port/timeout defaults, FRIDA untouched, one config_unknown_tool_skipped warning.

parse_tools ghidra path='/opt/ghidra'; oracle = Path('/opt/ghidra') + GHIDRA defaults; asserts exact path conversion and all non-path fields remain defaults. Plus separate invalid-path-type test asserting config_invalid_tool_path warning and None fallback.
parse_sub_configs({}); oracle = SandboxConfig()/UIConfig()/SessionConfig()/LogConfig(); asserts each returned sub-config equals its full default dataclass.
parse_sub_configs with partial custom values; oracle = explicit custom values + documented defaults; asserts overrides applied AND every unspecified field falls back to its default.

Real TOML file written and Config.load; oracle = parsed values + defaults; asserts provider/sandbox/ui from file and confirmation/log defaults. Plus missing-file (FileNotFoundError) and malformed-TOML (tomllib.TOMLDecodeError) error-path tests.

Config with non-default values across every section -> save -> Config.load; oracle = original instance; asserts full round-trip of provider/confirmation/dirs/providers/tools/sandbox/ui/session/log. Plus save-without-tomli_w ImportError error-path test.
get_project_root(); oracle = repo marker files; asserts src/ dir, pyproject.toml, src/intellicrack/core/config.py exist and the imported config module file is relative_to(root).

get_config_dir(); oracle = name/parent/absolute relationship; asserts name=='.intellicrack', parent==get_project_root(), is_absolute. Plus writable test (monkeypatch root to tmp_path, write+read providers.json) proving the dir actually holds files.
get_config_file('providers.json'); oracle = config_dir join semantics; asserts name, parent==get_config_dir(), is_absolute, and os.sep present in rendered path.
